title: Small Language Model enabled Autonomous agent for Language-Conditioned Cognitive Radar
abstract: arXiv:2608.11596v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern radar systems require adapting their processing strategies in response to changing interference, clutter, and data availability. This paper introduces a framework for a small language model (SLM)-driven autonomous agent designed for language-conditioned cognitive radar, functioning as an intelligent controller for a suite of array signal processing tools. Given a natural-language command, the agent extracts radar-operation-related cues, selects an appropriate sequence of signal-processing methods, configures parameters, and invokes executable tools for numerical computation. Experiments with a synthetic uniform linear array (ULA) radar demonstrate that, given a natural-language command, the agent performs meaningful algorithm selection across diverse scenarios for sidelobe control, jammer suppression, multiple-null beamforming, coherent-source handling, and low-snapshot direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation. translated_title: 小语言模型赋能的自主智能体用于语言条件认知雷达
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11596v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：现代雷达系统需要根据变化的干扰、杂波和数据可用性来调整其处理策略。本文提出了一种由小语言模型（SLM）驱动的自主智能体框架，用于语言条件认知雷达，作为一套阵列信号处理工具的智能控制器。给定一个自然语言命令，该智能体提取与雷达操作相关的线索，选择合适的信号处理方法序列，配置参数，并调用可执行工具进行数值计算。在合成均匀线性阵列（ULA）雷达上的实验表明，给定自然语言命令，该智能体在多种场景下能够进行有意义的算法选择，包括旁瓣控制、干扰抑制、多零陷波束形成、相干源处理以及低快拍到达方向（DOA）估计。消融研究结果显示...
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于小语言模型的自主智能体框架，能根据自然语言命令自动选择并配置雷达信号处理算法，实现认知雷达的智能控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an autonomous agent framework driven by a small language model that automatically selects and configures radar signal processing algorithms based on natural language commands, enabling intelligent control of cognitive radar.
